description: Use when writing backend or API-key integration code for Didit Face Search (POST /v3/face-search/), a standalone 1:N search against every face enrolled in the application: verification sessions, saved standalone calls, faces uploaded to User profiles, face lists and retained biometric templates. Use when detecting duplicate accounts, checking whether a face already exists, preventing repeat registrations, screening a face against the face blocklist, or investigating fraud rings. Returns up to 5 ranked matches with similarity percentages, match source and session details, plus blocklist and duplicate-face warnings.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
